probe_meta.label: dense-G (controlled retrieval-mechanism swap of Probe G)

response_text:
1. (Currently amended) A humeral implant comprising a first component removably attached to a second component, wherein said first component is a humeral surface component that is not spherically shaped.

2. (Currently amended) The humeral implant of claim 1 wherein said first component is a humeral surface component and said second component is a removably attached stem.

3. (Currently amended) The implant of claim 2 wherein said humeral surface component has a coronal radius of curvature and an axial radius of curvature that are different from one another.

9. (Currently amended) The implant of claim 3 wherein said humeral surface component is elliptically shaped.

13. (Currently amended) The implant of claim 3 wherein said humeral surface component has a smooth articulating surface with a surface finish that is polished or burnished.

20. (Currently amended) The implant of claim 2 wherein said removably attached stem has a selectable length from a plurality of available stem lengths, wherein a selected stem extends from a lateral cortex of said humerus to a center of a head of said humerus.

21. (Currently amended) The implant of claim 2 wherein said humeral surface component connects to said removably attached stem.

22. (Currently amended) The implant of claim 21 wherein said humeral surface component connects to said removably attached stem by a technique selected from the group consisting of morse taper and a threaded screw connection.

27. (Currently amended) A glenohumeral joint implant adapted to be implanted in a glenohumeral joint, comprising an implant adapted to provide a transhumeral portal along a central axis of a neck of a proximal humerus.

28. (Currently amended) The glenohumeral joint implant of claim 27 wherein said implant is a humeral implant.

29. (Currently amended) A humerus bone implant comprising a modular implant with a humeral surface component and a stem, wherein said stem is adapted to be anchored in the epiphyseal-metaphyseal portion of a humerus bone.
